composition_variation: Create a warm illustration of Usopp admiring a small handmade lighthouse model on a tidy workbench. Keep his recognizable long nose, curly dark hair, and cheerful goggles, with a fully clothed olive work outfit. His open palms rest gently beside the model. Use amber gouache, muted denim blues, woodgrain, and a round window showing calm sea. Avoid tools that resemble weapons. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
